svg.style: fill: none; fill-opacity: 1; stroke: rgb(38, 40, 42); stroke-width: 1.6px; stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; opacity: 1; filter: none; mix-blend-mode: normal; font-family: Jost, "Jost Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 380; letter-spacing: normal; text-anchor: start; visibility: visible; display: block; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none;
